findings.title: tests/inv/ RED-case enforcement is keyed on `$0` matching `*/tests/inv/test_*.sh`, so it silently does not fire under relative invocation (`bash tests/run.sh`, or `/bin/bash tests/inv/test_INV-13_....sh` as several tasks' verification_commands do) — while kernel.md, contributing.md and helpers.sh all state it applies by path and cannot be opted out of, and test_red_case_rule.sh section 4 proves it only with an absolute fixture path, so its RED case cannot detect the gap
